description: Defines the SettingsDelegate class which manages various delegate objects related to user settings, system, network, and lifecycle, including methods for handling app event notifications, setting shell context, and cleanup.

classes.name: SettingsDelegate
classes.description: Manages delegate objects for app settings, system, network, and lifecycle, providing methods for event handling, shell setup, and cleanup.

methods.name: HandleAppEventNotifier
methods.description: Handles app event notifications by delegating to registered delegates and logging errors if no delegate handles the event or if registration fails.

methods.name: setShell
methods.description: Initializes delegate objects with the provided shell context if they are not already initialized.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Resets all delegate shared pointers, effectively cleaning up resources.

methods.name: getSystemDelegate
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the SystemDelegate object.

methods.name: getUserSettings
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the UserSettingsDelegate object.

methods.name: getNetworkDelegate
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the NetworkDelegate object.

methods.name: getLifecycleDelegate
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the LifecycleDelegate object.
